settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineSalesNotice: Your sales are safely saved on the phone. They'll go to the server as soon as the network comes back.
settings.regionalPreferencesSubtitle: Configure the checkout currency and the display language for your terminal and back office.
settings.currencyComplianceNote: For accounting compliance reasons, changing the main currency requires an administrator's intervention.
settings.instantSyncNotice: Instant sync across all your terminals
settings.legalIdentifiersHint: Shown on every issued invoice — changing this never modifies an invoice already issued.
settings.taxHint: Selling prices include VAT: the tax is extracted from the displayed price, not added on top. An item's rate comes from the item, otherwise from its category, otherwise from the shop default below.
settings.taxEnabledOn: VAT is applied: receipts show net, VAT and gross.
settings.taxNeedRate: Add a rate below first to be able to enable VAT.
settings.taxZeroHint: A small shop that is not VAT-registered leaves VAT off: no tax block on receipts. A 0% rate is for exempting only some items: the receipt then shows a VAT line at 0.
settings.taxDefaultHelp: Applies to items whose item and category have no rate of their own.
settings.taxChangeRateHelp: Changing a rate does not affect sales already recorded: they keep the rate of their date.
settings.taxCountryHelp: Determines the official VAT rates offered below.
settings.taxOfficialHelp: An official rate automatically follows the country's legal changes, including ones scheduled in advance. Editing it by hand detaches it: you can go back at any time.
settings.taxOfficialNone: No official rate is available for this country yet: add your rates by hand below.
settings.discountThresholdDescription: Above this percentage, a discount granted by a seller requires manager approval (owner password) before it can be applied to the sale.
settings.ownerOnlyEditSetting: Only the shop owner can change this setting.
settings.sellingPriceDecimalsHelp: Lets you sell at 333.33 even in a currency without decimals. The amount to pay stays rounded to the currency unit, line by line. Prices already saved and past sales never change. To go back to fewer decimals, first fix the products that have a more precise price.
settings.costMethodHelp: Chooses what a stock arrival does to an item's purchase cost, and therefore to its margin. Past sales keep their cost and never change; only arrivals recorded afterwards are affected.

costMethodDescription.MANUAL: An arrival never changes the cost: only the item sheet does.
costMethodDescription.LAST_PRICE: The item's cost becomes that of the latest arrival.
costMethodDescription.WEIGHTED_AVERAGE: The cost is the average of the current stock and the arrival, weighted by quantity.
